nom: Tanologist Super Shield Face Mist SPF 50

avis.texte: What a disappointing product! I've used the Tanologist Super Shield Face Fluid with good results so I thought I'd try the mist to be able to reapply easily for a longer day out. I applied this 3x over a day out in the sun (6.5 hours) and my face burned horribly! I am not pale either, I am warm beige with olive undertones, tan easily and rarely burn. Not a beach or pool day witber, just a day at an amusement park. I used Vacation's Classic SPF 50 spray on my extremities and they did not burn. To add insult to injury this stung my eyes horribly. I would not recommended this to my worst enemy.
Burns your eyes like no other!!! Super greasy and it ends up migrating to my hair. I get sad everytime i dig through my purse and see this pink bottle and the disappointment it holds.
I had high hopes for this spray but is incredibly greasy. Will use it up and be done with it. Very disappointed.

I ordered this as a secondary SPF that I could use over makeup due to 2 precancerous spots on my face. I was very disappointed after I tried it, horrible greasy finish with a terrible feeling on my face and to make matters worse it stung my eyes very badly. I will be returning this asap.

I think maybe this product has so many great reviews because they were gifted/ sponsored, but to give you a heads-up, the fragrance is very strong. It's a kinda yummy and fruity smell, but gets old very fast, is incredibly strong, doesn't fade, and doesn't go away completely after a double cleanse. Ended up stinging the eyes too. Good luck out there finding a good face spf spray, still on the lookout myself.

The smaller spray bottle was perfect for travel. No complaints about the product at first. Then I used it to reapply while out at a park. Had been there for a while & didn't notice any bees. After reapply, THE BEES. For the rest of the day, always had one chasing me.

avis.titre: Easy on the go sun protection
avis.texte: I'm loving how easy this Super Sheer Face Mist SPF 50 is to reapply—I carry it with me everywhere! It gives a dewy, hydrated finish that works beautifully on my dry skin, and I never have to worry about a white cast, even over makeup. The spray does come out strong, so I recommend applying at a safe distance and in a continuous sweeping motion for even coverage. It's lightweight, layers great over skincare or foundation, and gives a refreshing cooling effect thanks to the Insta Cooling Complex—perfect for hot summer days This mist is a total game-changer for reapplying SPF without disrupting your look plus it gives broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection. I received this product complimentary from tanologisttan.
